throughput.name: 8 taken JIRLs to the next instruction
throughput.asm: la.local $r4, 1f; addi.d $r5, $r4, 4; addi.d $r6, $r4, 8; addi.d $r7, $r4, 12; addi.d $r8, $r4, 16; addi.d $r9, $r4, 20; addi.d $r10, $r4, 24; addi.d $r11, $r4, 28; 1:; jirl $r0, $r4, 4; jirl $r0, $r5, 4; jirl $r0, $r6, 4; jirl $r0, $r7, 4; jirl $r0, $r8, 4; jirl $r0, $r9, 4; jirl $r0, $r10, 4; jirl $r0, $r11, 4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 20 --asm 'la.local $r4, 1f; addi.d $r5, $r4, 4; addi.d $r6, $r4, 8; addi.d $r7, $r4, 12; addi.d $r8, $r4, 16; addi.d $r9, $r4, 20; addi.d $r10, $r4, 24; addi.d $r11, $r4, 28; 1:; jirl $r0, $r4, 4; jirl $r0, $r5, 4; jirl $r0, $r6, 4; jirl $r0, $r7, 4; jirl $r0, $r8, 4; jirl $r0, $r9, 4; jirl $r0, $r10, 4; jirl $r0, $r11, 4'
throughput.notes: 8 JIRLs plus 8 pcaddi/addi target-setup instructions take 8.78 cycles. The same setup without JIRLs takes 1.96 cycles, so marginal JIRL throughput is (8.78-1.96)/8 = 0.8525 CPI.

notes: Taken indirect branch throughput. Latency is not defined. The measurement sequence includes target-setup instructions; baseline_cycles is subtracted.
